# dsh-linkify
**English** · 简体中文
Clickable links in your own chat messages for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) client: text you send as `l
abel` or a bare `https://…` URL renders as a clickable link inside your own message bubble. Clicks o
pen the built-in browser tab (or `window.open` when that tab is unavailable).
It also fixes a real problem: when you copy link-bearing text from a browser or a chat app into DSH,
the rich text's `href` is dropped and only the label survives. With this plugin, pasting converts i
t to `label`, so the link survives.
## What it does

- `label` and bare `https://…` in a user message → underlined, clickable link
- Pasting rich text wi

th hyperlinks → converted to `label` on the way into the composer (inserted exactly once)
- The comp
oser itself still shows markdown source — DSH's composer is a plain-text editor and cannot render li

nks in place
- Links in assistant replies are native DSH markdown and unrelated to this plugin
## Compatibility
Requires DSH `0.2.2` or newer (`engines.dsh: ^0.2.2-0`). The plugin uses the `conversation.user.text
.node` slot, the `uiConversation.userText` rule API and the `sidebarRight` browser tab, all availabl
`uiConversation.userText` rule API and the `sidebarRight` browser tab, all available since `0.2.2`.
